edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The purchase price for the Shares (the “Purchase Price”) is [INSERT AGREED AMOUNT BEFORE SIGNING]. Buyer shall pay the Purchase Price to Seller at Closing by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Seller in writing.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall take place on [INSERT AGREED DATE BEFORE SIGNING] by electronic exchange of signed documents and the wire transfer specified in Section 1. The parties’ obligations to close are subject only to: (a) the other party’s representations being true in all material respects at Closing; (b) the other party having performed in all material respects its obligations required before Closing; (c) no order of a court or governmental authority prohibiting Closing being in effect; and (d) Seller delivering executed instruments transferring the Shares to Buyer against Buyer’s payment of the Purchase Price. A condition may be waived only in writing by the party entitled to its benefit. There are no other closing conditions.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. Seller represents that the financial statements delivered to Buyer have been prepared in accordance with the accounting principles identified in those statements, consistently applied, and fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations for the periods presented, subject to any qualifications stated in those statements and the disclosures in a disclosure schedule delivered by Seller and accepted by Buyer before signing.

4. INDEMNITY. Seller shall indemnify Buyer against losses arising from Seller’s breach of a representation or obligation in this Agreement, subject to the qualifications and disclosures expressly applicable to that representation or obligation. No representation or indemnity is made concerning liabilities solely by reason of their not being separately listed in this Agreement.

receiver.message_back: We cannot confirm a purchase price or closing date until our client approves both, and neither may be left blank at signing. The proposed closing mechanics and conditions are acceptable in principle, but our client does not accept Sections 3 and 4 as drafted: please provide any proposed disclosure schedule for review and remove the blanket exclusion for liabilities not separately listed in the Agreement.

delivered.body: Share Purchase Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between the Seller and Meridian Acquisitions LLC as Buyer. 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The purchase price for the Shares (the “Purchase Price”) shall be the amount agreed by the parties in writing before signing and shall be paid by the Buyer to the Seller in immediately available funds at Closing. 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days after signing, on a date and by a method agreed in writing by the parties, subject to satisfaction or waiver of any closing conditions agreed by the parties. 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements are accurate. 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller indemnifies the Buyer against undisclosed liabilities.
